title: Johnny B. Goode
lyrics:
[00:17.67] Deep down in Louisiana close to New Orleans
[00:20.32] Way back up in the woods among the evergreens
[00:23.12] There stood a log cabin made of earth and wood
[00:26.14] Where lived a country boy named Johnny B. Goode
[00:28.75] Who never ever learned to read or write so well
[00:31.36] But he could play a guitar just like a-ringin' a bell
[00:34.27] Go go
[00:36.08] Go Johnny go go
[00:38.91] Go Johnny go go
[00:41.79] Go Johnny go go
[00:44.60] Go Johnny go go
[00:47.95] Johnny B. Goode
[00:51.35] He used to carry his guitar in a gunny sack
[00:54.35] Go sit beneath the tree by the railroad track
[00:56.97] Oh, the engineers would see him sitting in the shade
[01:00.13] Strumming with the rhythm that the drivers made
[01:02.90] The people passing by they would stop and say
[01:05.64] "Oh my well that little country boy could play"
[01:08.38] Go go
[01:10.30] Go Johnny go go
[01:13.15] Go Johnny go go
[01:16.02] Go Johnny go go
[01:18.94] Go Johnny go go
[01:22.65] Johnny B. Goode
[02:00.38] His mother told him, "Someday you will be a man"
[02:03.47] "And you will be the leader of a big old band"
[02:06.13] "Many people coming from miles around"
[02:09.03] "To hear you play your music when the sun go down"
[02:11.91] "Maybe someday your name will be in lights"
[02:14.66] "Saying, Johnny B. Goode tonight"
[02:16.79] Go go
[02:17.96] Go Johnny go
[02:19.91] Go go go Johnny go
[02:23.01] Go go go Johnny go
[02:25.96] Go go go Johnny go
[02:29.54] Go
